name: Jagjeevan Singh Soni
about: At Amdocs, I work on enterprise telecom systems, from CRM and order management to release automation and production support. My projects extend that engineering practice into audio recognition, computer vision, and brain–computer interfaces.

areas.title: CRM & order management
areas.text: Developed and enhanced enterprise CRM and Order Management System capabilities using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Oracle SQL to support B2B telecom order processing and service delivery.

areas.title: Cross-system integration
areas.text: Collaborated across CRM, OMS, provisioning, and billing teams on integrated business workflows, including order orchestration, Master Enterprise Catalog (MEC), and Kenan billing integration.

areas.title: End-to-end delivery
areas.text: Owned business-critical CRM enhancements from requirement analysis and solution development through testing, production deployment, and issue resolution, coordinating technical dependencies and changing business requirements.

areas.title: Deployment validation application
areas.text: Designed and developed a Python and Flask application using Oracle Database and OpenPyXL to automate database verification, release tracking, and Excel and email reporting across testing, pre-production, and production environments.

areas.title: Linux infrastructure migration
areas.text: Delivered application script migration from legacy 32-bit Linux infrastructure to a 64-bit environment, coordinating integration validation, production cutover, and post-deployment monitoring.

areas.title: Release delivery & production support
areas.text: Supported recurring releases through Git, Jenkins, and CI/CD workflows, and resolved production and regression defects.

areas.title: Telecom product foundations
areas.text: Completed structured Amdocs CRM and OMS product training covering telecom Business Support Systems, customer and account management, order lifecycles, and the workflows connecting service fulfillment and billing.

areas.title: Application enhancements
areas.text: Implemented application enhancements and resolved defects using Java, Spring Boot, and SQL, translating defined business requirements into functionality within an Agile development environment.

areas.title: Customer notifications & previews
areas.text: Enhanced a CRM notification framework for communication triggered by order creation, updates, and amendments. Developed an interface feature to preview notification templates and associated product parameters.

areas.title: Notification release automation
areas.text: Automated template conversion, Git check-ins, change package generation, and deployment imports to standardize notification release workflows and reduce repetitive preparation.

areas.title: Developer utilities & investigation
areas.text: Developed and adapted utilities for Java dependency analysis, SQL rollback generation, and secure file transfer, while contributing to root-cause investigations and retrospectives.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering
education.school: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology

skills.description: From signals and images to useful models.

recognition.title: Ownership & Excellence
recognition.text: Recognized for dependable ownership, customer relationships, and technical contributions to CRM release delivery.

recognition.title: Special Recognition
recognition.text: Recognized on two occasions for contributions, sustained commitment, and dedication to work.

recognition.title: Software engineering virtual programs
recognition.text: Completed practical simulations involving stock-price data integration, financial visualization, and password-security analysis.

recognition.title: Secure software development
recognition.text: Completed training in secure coding principles, secure application development, and web application security.

community.title: Event Management Head
community.text: Organized cultural festivals and talks, coordinated event planning, and led student teams.

community.title: Public Relations Head
community.text: Supported hackathons, guest lectures, and webinars through publicity and sponsorship outreach.

community.title: Community service & student engagement
community.text: Contributed to food distribution and pandemic relief activities, student outreach, and Model United Nations research and debate.

summary: Software developer with enterprise telecom experience, demonstrating progressive responsibility, ownership and a structured approach to problem solving. Brings a methodical working style, accountability for delivery and experience collaborating across technical and business teams. Committed to advancing expertise through graduate study, connecting academic knowledge with practical experience to strengthen technical judgment and address complex engineering challenges.
